verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada's own services-fees-and-processing-times page states exact amounts per transaction: incorporation costs $200 online, the 4-hour express option adds $100, filing by email or mail costs $250, amendments cost $200, and an exemption costs $250. Processing times are listed alongside each fee, so a founder gets real figures rather than a contact form. Missing for 10: a published amount for the annual return filing (that page gives no fee), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the listed fees.
